artworks.title: Four-Master (Left) and Two Three-Masters Anchored near a Fortified Island with a Lighthouse
artworks.artist: Frans Huys after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.description: The image displays a maritime scene with three sailing ships, a fortress with a cylindrical tower emitting smoke, and a rowboat in the water. The style is detailed with fine lines, creating texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing the scene's contrasts.

artworks.title: Conrad Celtis
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed engraving of a person seated in the center of an ornate frame. The individual is in a frontal position with a serious facial expression, featuring a strong jawline, prominent nose, high cheekbones, and wavy hair just below a cap. They are dressed in luxurious clothing with a fur-collared coat. The frame is adorned with pillars, cherub-like figures, scrolling foliage, and Latin inscriptions. Cherubs flank the bottom of the frame, and the background is filled with decorative elements.

artworks.title: The Imperial Eagle
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an allegorical scene featuring an eagle surrounded by symbols and motifs. The eagle has widespread wings and is adorned with crowns. Surrounding the eagle are circular emblems with Latin inscriptions and illustrations representing virtues, arts, and sciences. There are vignettes of figures engaged in scholarly and artisanal pursuits, alongside mythological representations. The inscriptions focus on education and accomplishments. The drawing showcases detailed line work and engraving, reflecting a historical or philosophical theme from the Renaissance period.

artworks.title: Selbstbildnis (Self-Portrait)
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait focusing on the head and shoulders of a person facing forward, with their head slightly turned to the side. The person's face is shadowed with strong contrast, highlighting facial features such as a prominent brow, deep-set eyes, and a stern mouth. The hair appears dark and tousled, blending into the shaded areas. The clothing is sketched with minimal detail, suggesting a collared garment. The background is plain, putting emphasis on the subject. Visible writing at the top right may be a date or signature.

artworks.title: Bildnis Joseph Schwarz (Portrait of Joseph Schwarz)
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body of a person sitting, with hands resting in front of them. The person is shown facing forward with a slightly turned head. They have distinct facial features including a strong jawline, full lips, and deep-set eyes. The hair is dark and depicted as thick and somewhat unkempt. The individual is wearing a suit jacket with lapels and a shirt with a dark tie or cravat. The sketch is monochromatic, predominantly black lines on an off-white background, with the artist's signature at the bottom. There is no detailed background in the image.

artworks.title: Fortitude
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene involving a figure and a lion. The artwork portrays a figure with a draped garment around the waist, one shoulder exposed. The figure is walking to the left, holding a leash attached to a lion beside them. At their feet is a flame-like design. The background shows mountains, a river, and distant architecture. Trees with detailed foliage frame the scene. The drawing style is intricate, with fine lines and cross-hatching defining the elements in a tranquil yet wild landscape.

artworks.title: The Teacher, the Clergyman, and Providence
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals in a medieval woodcut style. The person on the left is standing upright, facing slightly left, and holding a long, curved ribbon-like object. They have a prominent nose, thin angular facial features, and wear a tall pointed hat. They are dressed in long robes with wide sleeves. The second person is standing but turned slightly to the right, appearing stockier with a round face and a prominent chin, wearing a hat with a bent brim. They hold a book with an 'X' on its spine. The third figure stands to the far right, facing the viewer with long hair and an extensive beard in a sunburst pattern. They wear a robe and carry a cross. The scene has minimal background elements, with flowing banners containing text above each person in gothic style script.

artworks.title: Time and a Fox Turning the Wheel of Fortune with People of all Ranks to the Right
Feste de Diane, Troublee par des Satyres (Feast of Diana Disrupted by Satyrs)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring nymphs and satyrs in a forested landscape. The detailed line work and shading depict a group of nymphs gathered around a central statue or altar. Satyrs approach from the edges of the scene, with a background of lush vegetation. An inscription at the bottom offers a narrative context for the scene.

artworks.title: Feste de Bacchus, celebree par des Satyres et des Bacchantes (Feast of Bacchus Celeb rated by Satyrs and Bacchanales)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of mythological creatures celebrating around a central statue or figure. The scene is detailed with lush natural surroundings and dynamic poses. The creatures are adorned with garlands and some hold musical instruments. In the foreground, there are various foods and fruits.

artworks.title: Feste du Dieu Pan, celebree par des Sylvains et des Nymphes (Feast of the God Pan Celebrated by Sylvans and Nymphs)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a celebration involving various figures in a lush, natural setting. The scene is densely packed with figures of different forms, some holding musical instruments, some dancing, and others presenting offerings or carrying garlands of foliage and flowers. The central figure is seated on an elevated platform, surrounded by a lively crowd. The background features an abundant landscape with trees and what appears to be an arch or cave entrance. The detailed artistry emphasizes fluid motion and harmonious interaction among the figures, capturing the essence of a vibrant, mythological festivity.

artworks.title: La Naissance (Birth)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a forest scene with numerous figures and animals. It depicts a variety of human-like figures and goats gathered around a central event. Many of the figures are nude and engaged in different activities. The trees are detailed with foliage, creating a sense of depth. Young goats and other hybrid creatures are scattered throughout the scene. The drawing emphasizes the natural environment and suggests a narrative rich in myth or allegory.

artworks.title: L'Education (Education)
artworks.description: The image displays a crowded scene with satyrs and figures in a forest. The viewpoint seems slightly elevated. The horizon is not visible due to the dense trees. Various figures are engaged in different actions. The style is highly detailed with fine lines creating a textured look. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of beige and brown. The trees at the edges create a sense of depth.

artworks.title: Le Mariage (Marriage)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythical marriage scene. The drawing depicts a forest setting populated with various mythological creatures, such as satyrs, gathered around a central area. Satyrs are prominently featured, with their characteristic horns and furry legs, mingling and engaging in activities such as playing musical instruments and carrying objects. Some are seated while others stand or recline. The environment is detailed with trees and what might appear as ancient ruins or structures adding texture and depth to the setting. The mood is lively yet mysterious, with an intricate composition that invites the viewer to explore its ancient and mythical themes.

artworks.title: Les Obseques (The Funeral Rites)
artworks.description: The image shows an outdoor scene viewed from a slightly elevated angle. Tall trees line the horizon, framing a central ornate structure. The art style is meticulous and engraved, with fine lines and intricate details. The color palette is primarily brown. Figures in classical attire are engaged in activities, with more figures around a central monument. In the background, lush foliage fills the horizon.

artworks.title: God the Father with His Right Hand Raised in Blessing
artworks.medium: leadpoint(?), pen and brown ink and wash, heightened with white on cream-colored prepared(?) paper laid down on wood panel
artworks.description: The image displays an upper body view of a figure with only the head, shoulders, and arms visible. The figure is positioned frontally with the head slightly bowed. Facial features are solemn with a full, long, and wavy beard, and the figure has long hair flowing down to the shoulders. The individual is wearing a robe with a visible sleeve pattern. The left hand is raised with fingers arranged in a gesture, while the right hand is holding an open book. The background is a muted and textured surface, possibly depicting an aged or weathered wall, with faint geometric shapes suggesting a halo or aura surrounding the figure's head.

artworks.title: Orphan Man, Standing
artworks.medium: crayon lithograph with scraping on tan wove paper
artworks.description: Printed with black and gray on tan-colored paper, a man wearing military-style clothing and a brimless cap stands holding a stick down by one side in this vertical lithograph. The man’s body is angled to our left, and he looks down and to our left with an unfocused gaze. His brows are gathered, and he has a beak-like nose, high cheekbones, a wide, cleft chin, and his lips are downturned. He has substantial white mutton chops, and his cap flares up to a flat top. His double-breasted vest is buttoned, and his shin-length coat hangs open. His pants are baggy over square-toed shoes. His left hand, to our right, hangs by his side, and the other hand holds the stick like a long sword at rest. The artist signed the print in the lower left corner of the image, “Vincent.” An inscription added below reads “épreuve d’essai.”

artworks.title: Potato Eaters
artworks.medium: crayon lithograph with scraping printed in dark brown on thin wove paper
artworks.description: This is a grayscale print that shows a group of five people sitting around a table, sharing a meal under a solitary hanging lamp. The women wear dark dresses with white cloth bonnets, while the men wear dark jackets and pants with gray caps. The people all have light skin and pronounced cheekbones, and they look at the table or at each other with solemn expressions. The person closest to us has their back to us, and they are facing the table and partially blocking our view. A woman on the left pours a tea kettle into something at the center of the table that we can't see. There appears to be a large plate on the table with steam rising from it. Some of the people point toward the plate. The room around them is gray, with some indistinct objects hung on the walls.

artworks.title: Baco (Bacchus)
artworks.medium: etching on heavy laid paper [first edition impression printed in the Calcografia in 1778-79]
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people closely gathered together. A man with a muscular build sits at the center, partially covered by a cloth around his waist. He wears a wreath of leaves in his hair. Other figures surround him, some seated, others standing or crouched. The individuals have varied facial features and wear loose, rustic clothing. Some hold clay jugs or cups. The background includes detailed foliage, trees, and a textured landscape.

artworks.title: Baltasar Carlos
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on heavy laid paper [first edition impression printed in the Calcografia in 1778-79]
artworks.description: The image shows a young boy on horseback, displaying his entire body as he is seated in a riding position. The boy is positioned on the galloping horse with one arm raised, holding a short staff or baton. He has a distinct facial expression characterized by youthful features, with large, wide eyes and slight lips; his hair is not fully visible as a large, wide-brimmed hat covers most of it. The boy is wearing formal or regal attire, consisting of a layered, tailored outfit with a sash across his chest. The horse is adorned with a decorative harness. The background features a landscape with expansive skies filled with clouds and distant hills.

artworks.title: The Blind Singer
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint and/or lavis, drypoint and burin on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features an etching of a person from the waist up, seated and playing a guitar. The person appears reclined with their arms wrapped around the guitar. Their head is slightly tilted forward, with a shadowed face showcasing strong and serious facial features. They have short, dark hair and wear a large, dark hat. The person's clothing is loose-fitting and textured, giving the impression of layers and volume. One hand grips the guitar neck while the other strums the strings. The background consists of heavy, dark, swirling patterns, emphasizing the figure in the foreground.

artworks.title: Un enano (A Dwarf)
artworks.medium: etching on heavy laid paper [first edition impression printed in the Calcografia in 1778-79]
artworks.description: The image displays a seated figure with a focus from the knees up. The person is holding an open book with both hands while positioned slightly turned to the left. The facial features include a mustache, expressive eyes, and a prominent nose. The short hair is concealed under a large hat. The individual is wearing a textured garment with a collar. Surrounding the figure are books, scrolls, an ink pot, and a quill. The background is a hatched and textured space indicating an indoor setting. The image is in a monochromatic sepia tone.

artworks.title: Fiero monstruo! (Fierce Monster!)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint and burin on laid paper [trial proof printed posthumously Calcografia in or after 1870]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a large dog-like creature lying on the ground with something in its mouth. The drawing features a detailed depiction of a beast that appears to be eating or biting down on a figure. The texture of the beast's fur is rendered with dense, dark lines, giving a sense of volume and mass. The image has a strong contrast between dark and light areas, emphasizing the creature's form against a relatively plain background. The etching conveys a sense of tension, with the beast's posture suggesting both power and menace.

artworks.title: Gaspar de Guzman, Conde Duque de Olivares
artworks.medium: etching on heavy laid paper [first edition impression printed in the Calcografia in 1778-79]
artworks.description: The image depicts a man riding a horse while holding the reins with one hand and raising a baton or staff with the other hand. The man has a mustache and beard, wearing a wide-brimmed hat with a feather, a decorated coat, high boots, and a sash. The background shows a landscape with rolling hills, a distant townscape, trees on the right side, and a sky with detailed cloud patterns.
